notes.title: SBX: Invasion Demo now Available!
notes.content:
SBX: Invasion now has a short demo for you to try!  You can play through the first couple levels to get a feel for the game.

Check it out at:  http://store.steampowered.com/app/374210

Cheers and have fun!  I'll be periodically giving away full keys to people who write reviews too, so if you have feedback we'd love to hear it.

notes.title: Post a Review and Get a Key!
notes.content:
For anyone who owns SBX: Invasion - From now July 10th through the end of July, if you post a quality review, I'll send you an additional key for a friend!

We're just a little lacking in the reviews section, so if you take the time to post your honest feelings about the game, we'll send you an additional key.

It doesn't even have to be a positive review (although of course, we like those), but it does have to be quality and lay out your reasons for the score given.

I look forward to hearing your feedback and happy defending!

~Jason / WakeskaterX

notes.title: There is an error with the Store (FIXED)
notes.content:
I apologize for everyone who is waiting to get this game.  There is an error and the game can not be purchased.  I am contacting Steam to get this resolved.

Thank you for your patience!

Edit: The issue seems to be fixed and you should now be able to purchase the game, please reach out if you have any issues at all!
